angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 745,930 km at 41.69 pc = 0.24 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 23.9884 +/- 0.0259 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 41.69 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.072 (1.051 to 1.094) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 745,930 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.892 (0.852 to 0.933) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5553 +/- 3.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4153637759337630720: teff_gspphot 5553.191 K (16th-84th percentiles 5551.673-5559.1265), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4153637759337630720: teff_gspphot 5553.191 K (16th-84th percentiles 5551.673-5559.1265), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/alasia.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.328, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 168746 (pscomppars): spectral type G5, from Pepe et al. 2002 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2002A&A...388..632P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 168746 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.08 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 168746 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.04139, from Pepe et al. 2002 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2002A&A...388..632P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 168746 (pscomppars): age 8 Gyr, from Ghezzi et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010ApJ...720.1290G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 168746 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1 km/s, from Pepe et al. 2002 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2002A&A...388..632P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
